device_name.name: Device Name
device_name.description: Display name of the weather station in Home Assistant (e.g., 'Garden Weather Station').

device_identifier.name: Device Identifier
device_identifier.description: Unique internal slug for Home Assistant. Use lowercase letters and underscores only (e.g., 'my_weather_station').

station_id.name: Station ID (Optional)
station_id.description: If your station sends an 'ID' parameter and you want to restrict incoming data, enter it here (otherwise leave blank).

station_password.name: Station Password (Optional)
station_password.description: If your station sends an 'password' parameter and you want to restrict incoming data, enter it here (otherwise leave blank).

log_raw_data.name: Log Raw Data
log_raw_data.description: Enable to log all raw incoming HTTP request parameters (useful for finding extra/unsupported sensor keys).

sensors.name: Sensors Configuration
sensors.description: Configure entity mappings, measurement units, and device/state classes.

id.name: Sensor ID
id.description: Unique entity ID prefix in Home Assistant (e.g., 'outdoor_temp').

name.name: Display Name
name.description: Friendly name of the sensor shown in UI (e.g., 'Outdoor Temperature').

incoming_key.name: Incoming Key
incoming_key.description: URL parameter key received in the Wunderground request (e.g., 'tempf', 'humidity', 'baromin').

unit.name: Unit of Measurement
unit.description: Native unit of the incoming payload (e.g., '°F', '%', 'mph', 'inHg', 'in'). Home Assistant will automatically convert this to your preferred system units.

class.name: Device Class
class.description: Determines the sensor behavior and default icon in HA (e.g., temperature, humidity, pressure).

state_class.name: State Class
state_class.description: Required for HA statistics e.g., 'measurement' for instantaneous values, 'total_increasing' for accumulated rain.
